settings.card: Show the newest line on the discussion list
settings.card_help: A small card above the discussions with the newest line of the story being written and how long until the round closes.
settings.live_votes: Show vote counts while a round is open
settings.live_votes_help: Off, votes are revealed when the round closes, so early votes don't steer the rest.
settings.show_authors: Show who wrote each line while a round is open
settings.show_authors_help: Off, lines are anonymous until one wins, so members vote for the line, not the name. Moderators always see who wrote what.
settings.no_repeat: The writer of the newest line sits the next round out
settings.no_repeat_help: Keeps one fast writer from adding line after line. They can still vote.

page.title: Story Chain
page.lead: The forum writes a story together, one line at a time. Offer the next line, vote for your favorite, and the winning line joins the story.
page.library_lead: Finished stories, every line written by members.
page.empty_start: Start the first one. All it takes is an opening line.
page.load_error: The stories couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
page.not_found: This story doesn't exist, or it was deleted.
